package-version-ids.description: Comma separated string of package version ids to delete.

owner.description: Owner of the repo containing the package version to delete. Defaults to the owner of the repo running the action.

package-name.description: Name of the package containing the version to delete.

package-type.description: Type of package. Can be one of container, maven, npm, nuget, or rubygems.

num-old-versions-to-delete.description: Number of versions to delete starting with the oldest version. Defaults to 1.

min-versions-to-keep.description: Number of versions to keep starting with the latest version By default keeps no version. To delete all versions set this as 0.

ignore-versions.description: Regex pattern for package versions to ignore. Defaults to delete all versions.

delete-only-pre-release-versions.description: Deletes only pre-release versions. The number of pre-release versions to keep can be specified by min-versions-to-keep. When this is set num-old-versions-to-del

delete-only-untagged-versions.description: Deletes only untagged versions in case of a container package. Does not work for other package types. The number of untagged versions to keep can be specified b

token.description: Token with the necessary scopes to delete package versions. If num-old-versions-to-delete is used the token also needs the read packages scope. Defaults to gith
